CDN media inventory + best-variant resolution shared by the
Sourcesrc/shared/scripts/build/media-manifest.mjs
UX surfaceThe repo verbs — build, verify, test, docs, i18n, media, setup, scaffold.

Members

MEDIA_PREFIX

Object-name prefix every public media asset lives under on the bucket.

LIST_ENDPOINT

Anonymous storage.objects.list endpoint — the bucket is public.

IMAGE_VARIANTS

Image-variant priority for indexing — highest available quality first: the mozjpeg uncompressed pass, then the raw original, then q50, then the kodak blur thumb. The first suffix that exists on the bucket wins.

VIDEO_CONTENT_VARIANTS

Video-content priority — full file first, scaledown fallback second.

VIDEO_THUMB_VARIANTS

Poster variants a video can expose, in preference order.

IMAGE_THUMB_VARIANTS

Image thumb/poster priority for previews (og:image, video posters).

pickVariant

First base-suffixed key from variants that exists in manifest.

(module scope)

Lists every object key under MEDIA_PREFIX → Set of names relative to the prefix (metcha/feed/x.jpg). Returns null when the listing fails so callers can fall back to the historic naming convention.

persistMediaManifest

Writes the key set next to the sitemap artifacts (<meta>/media-manifest.json) so the synchronous locale-page generator can reload it without network.

loadMediaManifest

Reads a previously persisted key set; null when absent/unreadable.

resolveMediaUrls

Resolves one media item to crawlable URLs — { source, thumb, isVideo }.

source is the highest-quality indexable variant (uncompressed pass → raw original → q50 → blur thumb); thumb is the poster/preview variant. With no manifest (listing failed) the historic convention is emitted — -mozjpg-uncompressed for images, .mp4/.mp4.jpg-thumb.jpg for video — matching the runtime URL builders in core/utils/media.ts.

resolveCoverKey

Resolves a home-mosaic cover image to its best indexable key.
